title: int:Order
description: A single buy (bid) or sell (offer) order submission to a market slot. Subclass of cim:MarketFactors. Mirrors the Rust EwdsOrderDto (camelCase wire form; epoch-integer timestamps).

orderType.description: Buy or sell order. IRI: int:orderType.

orderStatus.description: Lifecycle status of this order submission. IRI: int:orderStatus. Producers emit 'submitted'/'executed'/'cancelled'/'expired'; consumers additionally accept 'partially_filled', 'filled' and 'rejected' inbound.

timeSlot.description: Target delivery timeslot. IRI: int:timeSlot. Unix epoch (seconds).

quantity.description: Energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:quantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

priceLimit.description: Price limit in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:priceLimit. Unit: EUR/kWh.

energySourcePreference.description: Preferred energy source type. IRI: int:energySourcePreference.

energyType.description: Energy type classification for this order. IRI: int:energyType.

createdBy.description: FK to Actor who submitted. IRI: int:createdby.

creationTime.description: Order creation datetime. IRI: int:createdAt. Unix epoch (seconds).

updatedAt.description: Order last updated datetime. IRI: int:updatedAt. Unix epoch (seconds). Nullable.

rejectReason.description: Human-readable reject/cancellation reason. IRI: int:rejectionReason. Populated when orderStatus = cancelled or rejected. Nullable.

preferredTradingPartner.description: Preferred trading partner. IRI: int:preferredTradingPartner. Nullable.
